title: cards/{station}.json
description: Station card (F12, F15). Landmark names come from config/landmarks.yaml, coordinates verified at H0; never typed by hand. make web (C) merges WS3's horizon/public/cards/{S}.json (navcam, skyline_error_deg, panorama_png, landmarks) with WS2's engine/public/cards/{S}.timeline.json (timeline, margin_binding, contingency, access block); a station missing either part gets no card. v1.1.1: margin_binding may be null (no route or no access cell); optional access block and producer extras. v1.1.2: optional drag_note (D20, WS2 timeline part). v1.1.3: margin_binding may be "EVA duration" (D28); optional turn_back_binding. v1.1.4: optional landmark display (D33): "label" (above the computed skyline, labelled) or "bearing_tick" (below it, bearing-only tick).

dist_to_observer_m.description: frame position to the card observer, m (v1.1.1)

display.description: D33 (user 16:20): label = above the computed skyline, drawn as a label; bearing_tick = below it, a bearing-only compass tick (no elevation) (v1.1.4)

timeline.description: EVA time, min; null when the station is not on the route

margin_binding.description: the margin term that binds at this station; null when the station is not on the route or has no access cell (v1.1.1)

drag_note.description: D20: dragging a suited crewmate is infeasible (finding text from config/haul.yaml drag_note; WS2) (v1.1.2)

scenario.description: scenario of the timeline part, e.g. nom_104 (v1.1.1)

on_route.description: station is on the scenario's route (v1.1.1)

margin_min.description: binding margin at the station, min; null = not on the route (v1.1.1)

t_home_min.description: walk home from the access cell in the scenario, min (v1.1.1)

o2_home_L.description: O2 for that walk home, L (v1.1.1)

lon.description: access cell longitude, deg east; null = no access cell

lat.description: access cell latitude, deg; null = no access cell

dist_m.description: access_dist_m: science point to access cell, m; null = no access cell

t_home_min.description: walk home from the access cell, min

o2_home_L.description: O2 for the walk home from the access cell, L

reason.description: why there is no access cell (null when there is one)

walk_in.description: straight-line walk-in from the access cell to the science point; not modelled by the router (null when there is no access cell)

modelled.description: always false: the walk-in leg is not routed

rise_m.description: science point minus access cell height, m

mean_slope_deg.description: mean along-track slope, deg (3 m samples, bilinear on elev_3m)

max_terrain_slope_deg.description: max WS1 cell max-slope of the cells crossed, deg

access.description: access cell (C/user decision 2026-11-14 11:40): nearest walkable cell within access_radius_m of the science point; the route ends here and the card shows both points and the walk-in (v1.1.1, from WS2)

observer.description: WS3 horizon observer (science or access point, position label) (v1.1.1)

landmarks_note.description: why fewer than 3 landmarks are listed (v1.1.1)

parts.description: make web merge record: source file and producer of each part (v1.1.1)

turn_back_binding.description: Binding term of the turn-back time (D28, WS2).
